messages:
maya: Heads up — customer reported we marked a 7-day trial credit as 'granted' in the support console but they still see 0 credits in the billing UI and API. Case #CS-4892.
kevin: which path did you use to grant? support console UI or backoffice API?
sam: console -> Grants tab -> select promo -> Grant to user(email). I can repro on staging. Console shows success toast. No credits in /v1/customers/:id response.
maya: audit log shows event `grant_created` with id gc_78f2, status `complete`. Backoffice worker logs show `enqueue grant job` then `processed` for gc_78f2.
kevin: can you paste the worker log lines?
maya: sure:
```
2026-02-10T15:02:11Z worker-3 INFO enqueue grant job gc_78f2 user=acct_993
2026-02-10T15:02:12Z worker-3 INFO processed grant gc_78f2 -> billing_txn bt_44a
2026-02-10T15:02:12Z billing INFO created credit record credit_zz9 for acct_993
```
sam: that's weird — audit + billing log show created record but API reads 0. Could be cache / read-replica lag or a missing write to the customer's balance table used by the API.
ivar: I checked DB on primary — there is a credit row (credit_zz9) but `customer_balance` table was not updated. Looks like grant flow creates credit record but forgets to update denormalized balance if opts enabled.
maya: confirmed on staging: two different codepaths — admin console triggers `create_credit` but `sync_balance` job failed due to transient deadlock, worker retried and logged retry but the retry handler swallows errors and returns success.
kevin: that retry-swallower rings a bell — INF-998 was about retry policy. @ops-sre any alerts?
ops-sre: monitoring didn't fire (we don't track balance-sync failures separately). I just created an alert for `balance_sync_failures > 0` and enabled SLO burn on retries.
support-bot: Ticket CS-4892 linked to internal issue INF-1123 (grant flow: idempotency/retry fix) — assigned to @kevin.
kevin: thanks. Short-term workaround: run `jobs:reflow-balance --user acct_993` in backoffice. That updates balance correctly.
maya: did manual reflow and customer confirmed credits visible. I left note in the case and refunded any accidental double-grants.
sam: repro steps for devs: 1) grant via console 2) force worker to throw transient db deadlock (e.g., `BEGIN; SELECT FOR UPDATE` on balance) 3) let retry handler run 4) observe console success but missing balance.
ivar: patch suggestion: make the grant flow transactional or add a compensating step that verifies post-write and retries explicitly if balance missing. Also stop swallowing retry errors — surface metrics.
kevin: I'll open a minimal PR to change retry handler to bubble up failures and add a verification step after `create_credit` that asserts `customer_balance` increased (INF-1123).
ops-sre: also recommend adding a short TTL cache invalidation on the API side after grant — simplest mitigation for users hitting stale caches.
maya: filing notes: case updated, workaround and reflow steps added to KB. cc @sam for QA test.
sam: I'll add an e2e test that simulates deadlock and checks final balance.
kevin: thanks all — tracking INF-1123. Will post PR link when ready.
support-bot: INF-1123 status: triaged -> in_progress. Updates will be posted here.
